description: Controlled 192-run engineering pilot evaluating maximum-gain partial acceptance on interrupted MAPF-LNS repairs under planning deadlines (Upgrade Guide Section 10.4).
prior_data_exposure: Development/validation partition (random-64-64-10, warehouse-10-20-10-2-2) previously used for Phase 6-7 controller tuning and partial-prefix recovery diagnostic; untouched test partition (Paris_1_256, Berlin_1_256, warehouse-20-40-10-2-2, den520d, ost003d, brc202d) remains strictly unexposed.

base_repair_and_scheduling_policy.initial_planner: Prioritized Space-Time A* (shared fixture per map/scenario/agent_count, loaded outside refinement timer)
base_repair_and_scheduling_policy.neighborhood_selection: Uniform random subset without replacement using seeded std::mt19937

policies.name: RESUMPTION_NO_PA
policies.description: Macro-prefix checkpoint resumption (K=2, FIFO selective); partial acceptance disabled

policies.name: GREEDY_PARTIAL_ACCEPTANCE
policies.description: Resumption enabled (K=2, FIFO selective) + transitive dependency-aware greedy partial acceptance

policies.name: EXACT_PARTIAL_ACCEPTANCE
policies.description: Resumption enabled (K=2, FIFO selective) + exact min-cut maximum-weight closure partial acceptance

accounting: 2 maps * 3 scenarios * 2 agent counts * 2 seeds * 2 budgets * 1 slice * 4 policies = 192 runs
